_about: Seed for the idea-map issues in Linear (team NoSyntax, label idea-map). One issue per cell; title = '<id> — <title>'; description = this JSON cell. OPEN = unstarted state, CLOSED = completed state. CLOSED cells carry the inherited record of what 140+ pre-registered tests already killed on this universe (2022-2026) — Scout does not re-propose them without a NEW mechanism or NEW data named in evidence_on_file. Run tools/seed_idea_map.py once (idempotent: it searches titles first).

cells.title: Post-liquidation-cascade reversal in liquid names
cells.next_test: event = OI drop >= x% within 1h with volume >= y x 30-day median; horizon 4h-3d; liquid tercile only; controls: ordinary days, moderate down days
cells.notes: inherited: a 'fragility score' built on thin tape was INVERTED - cascades come from ACTIVE names (5-14x volume, 1.5-2.4x OI); a panic-day liquid-loser reversal (+181/+175 bp per 3d, t 2.5/2.1, controls clean) failed as a sleeve at book size because of entry/exit churn - WATCH

cells.title: Panic-day liquid-loser reversal as an execution rule rather than a sleeve
cells.next_test: do not trim liquid losers on panic days (EW alt <= -8% or BTC <= -7%); 3-day hold of forced buys; measure as a veto on the governor's trims, not as a sleeve
cells.notes: FOLLOW-UP: signal real, sleeve fails (+1.0/-0.2 %/yr at master's budget)
